test_title: PYST 23: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of the Yashoda AI initiative launched by the National Commission for Women (NCW) in May 2025?

options.text: To promote traditional crafts among women artisans
To provide financial assistance to women entrepreneurs
To enhance AI literacy and digital awareness among women
To offer healthcare services to rural women

solution:
The correct answer is __**To enhance AI literacy and digital awareness among women**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Yashoda AI initiative was launched by the National Commission for Women (NCW) in May 2025 to **empower women through AI literacy**.
 
• Its primary objective is to **bridge the digital divide** and equip women with knowledge about artificial intelligence technologies.
 
• The program aims to enhance the **digital awareness** of women, enabling them to leverage AI for personal and professional growth.
 
• This initiative focuses on building **digital and technological skills** among women, addressing the gender gap in technology adoption.
 
• Yashoda AI is expected to promote inclusivity by **providing tools and resources** for women to participate in the digital economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Artificial Intelligence (AI):**

 
 
• AI refers to the simulation of human intelligence in machines programmed to think like humans and mimic their actions.
 
• It encompasses technologies like machine learning, neural networks, and natural language processing.
 
• AI is widely used in industries such as healthcare, education, finance, and marketing for automation and efficiency.
 
 
 
• **Digital Literacy:**
 
 
• Digital literacy involves the ability to use technology effectively and responsibly for information access, communication, and problem-solving.
 
• It is crucial for participation in the modern digital economy and for closing the digital divide.
 
 
 
• **National Commission for Women (NCW):**
 
 
• NCW is a statutory body established in January 1992 under the National Commission for Women Act, 1990.
 
• Its primary role is to safeguard and promote the rights of women in India.
 
 
 
• **Gender Gap in Technology:**
 
 
• The gender gap in technology refers to disparities in access, usage, and representation of women in technological fields.
 
• Initiatives like Yashoda AI aim to address this gap by promoting digital inclusion and skill-building.
